A direct chronological backup of forniphilia-TF artist XY, sourced via gallery-DL up until they nuked their page sometime ~2024.

Bit of a filler entry; I just happened to notice they were nuked and made a note to throw 'em up next time I was doing the rounds. They were more extreme than I prefer myself.

Content derived from: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/55629021

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Note that I've also scraped thousands of other art accounts, for every eyecatching Transformation and TF-Adjacent (IE Hypno, Trait Change...) specialist I can find - so if someone you liked got nuked at any point post-2022, check https://zerobin.net/?9e1b4632b2a0edb0#g+Z0HZUY39NU8rWIighbyGhdsCBKgHJT0zBhlo71QwM= (or the more up to date 'interests' section of my forum profile) for an availability list, give me a DM if you see something what's been lost, and I'll see about throwing them in a gallery too.

I do also have raw .json files for most every file I've scraped, so if you're the sort to want post metadata as well, give me a ping and I'll hook you up there too.
